note: Yellow Medicine County's zoning is published only as a 2006 PDF zoning map (in the 2025 Comprehensive Plan) and ordinance text. The county ArcGIS server (gis.co.ym.mn.gov) lists DitchSystem, FloodHazardZones, StatewideReferenceLayers, Assessors/TaxParcels, Administrative/GeopoliticalAreas, Soils, and other services, but no zoning districts layer. The county Hub search returned no zoning dataset. Granite Falls and Canby publish zoning only in ordinance/PDF form; no city zoning service was found.
